secrets.name: The Brass Capsule
secrets.text: Inside the bottle's plinth, behind a bookcase that swings like a page, a round brass room with a desk, a lamp and a chair, riveted all over like the inside of a diving bell. Above you, through the floor, you can hear people going round and round.

meta.label: The Klein Bottle
meta.blurb: A bottle of brass hoops the size of a house stands in the atrium, lined with books inside. Its neck climbs out of its crown and comes down again to the gallery. If you walk up the neck, you come out inside the bottle. You never went through the wall. You went through the wall.
